items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Stock Could Trade Below Fair Value As Its 193% Run Continues
items.summary: AbbVie has delivered a powerful run over the past few years, and the share price now asks a simple question of every holder: Do the cash flows that underpin this large pharmaceutical group go far enough to support where AbbVie trades today, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying money coming in the door? Over the last 5 years AbbVie has returned 193.3%, which puts a lot of weight on whether the future stream of cash the business can earn is strong enough to back up that kind of share...
